title: Liquidated Damages on Contract Exits by Supplier Switch or Final Bill - C&I
content:
**§ Liquidated damages on a contract exit** - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts

Liquidated damages on a contract exit are billed on a contract that closed during its term because another supplier enrolled the facility or the utility final-billed it, meaning close reason switched to other supplier or final billed with a close date before the contract end date, as one early termination fee line per contract.

## Billing the damages: `bill_contract_exit_damages_2ce88247`

The agent unlocks `bill_contract_exit_damages_2ce88247` and then calls it.

**Capability.** One call adds one early termination fee line to the bill of a contract whose supply ended during its term because another supplier enrolled the facility or the utility final-billed it. The line is dated today and carries the dollar amount and the remaining contracted kWh passed; the net charges billed on the contract rise by that amount, and the line then appears among the contract's bill lines. The contract's status and dates are not changed.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `cni_contract_id` | the commercial and industrial contract number of the contract whose supply ended, as shown on the contract record returned by the contract lookup | contract number |
| `amount_usd` | the damages billed | US dollars, a positive number rounded half up to 2 decimal places; stored exactly as passed |
| `etf_remaining_kwh` | the remaining contracted kWh the damages were measured on | a whole number of kWh, no decimals |

**Return.** A confirmation carrying `cni_billing_id` (the reference number of the new bill line), `cni_contract_id` (the contract billed), `line_type`, always `early_termination_fee`, `amount_usd` (2 decimal places), `etf_remaining_kwh` (a whole number) and `posted_date` (today, YYYY-MM-DD). A returned `cni_billing_id` means the line is on the contract's bill.

## Scope by close record

| Close reason | Close date | In scope |
|---|---|---|
| switched to other supplier | before the contract end date | yes |
| final billed | before the contract end date | yes |
